Description: Generalize the existing FindAir gateway (apps/gateway, apps/rules-api) into the unified pipeline gateway described in SPEC-001 Rev 3: one rule index per pipeline, a shared pipeline catalog, and per-pipeline transport (RabbitMQ or HTTP). Reviewed against the current karisuke monorepo (.NET 10) before this breakdown was written, not from the spec alone.

New libs/pipeline-catalog binds the Pipelines config section and validates it at startup the way GatewaySettings.IsValid already does - bad transport config, missing routing keys, missing URLs, and duplicate pipeline IDs all fail fast instead of reaching production. New libs/pipeline-contracts defines IPipelineContract and the DispatchContext struct, with one real implementation for tile-builder that wraps what GatewayOutputMessageBuilder.cs already does, plus a first golden-file test. Wire both into Program.cs in gateway and rules-api so catalog and code can't silently drift.

Do this first - it sets the shared contract shape everything else (T2-T6) builds against.

Upgrade RuleDto to the v2 match/runParams shape, reject empty or catch-all rules unless matchAll: true is explicit, and keep the sensor -> registration-quality pairing intact (nested, never a map). Finish by extracting the shared logic into a new libs/rule-engine, so the simulate endpoint (T6b) runs the exact code that runs in production.
